name: Kevin from Accounting
blurb: Suit and tie on a scooter, weirdly vicious.

look.description: A short-sleeved dress shirt, a clip-on tie flapping over his shoulder and a lanyard badge. Rides a beige commuter scooter with a briefcase bungeed to the footboard.

meta.notes: Regular. M4 rivals-1 (built early): a grudge-keeper. He hunts you, always from your left, and keeps an exact tally: one hit on him puts you on his list for the rest of the race, and each further hit makes him swing more. His grudges never decay between races. Rivalry: The Mayor, over an unpaid invoice. Prefers the briefcase (weapons-2 adds it). Rides the starter bike until his scooter exists. Approved line: "Per my last email: move."
